title: Transitioning From Gymnast to Investor with Aly Raisman

reader_summary.headline: When you're competing at the Olympics, if I'm jet lag, or if I don't feel well.
reader_summary.overview: When you're competing at the Olympics, if I'm jet lag, or if I don't feel well, it's not like the judge's care. So at eight years old, it started to get really intense, and I would spend six days in the gym. I had Sundays off, and I would train somewhere between four to seven hours a day.

key_points.text: When I was training for the Olympics, like if I was tired.
key_points.evidence_quote: When I was training for the Olympics, like if I was tired, I felt like almost my coach was harder on me on the days where I didn't sleep well.

key_points.text: It took me so long to get diagnosed because doctors would say to me, well, you just have anxiety.
key_points.evidence_quote: It took me so long to get diagnosed because doctors would say to me, well, you just have anxiety.

key_points.text: And I'd say, well, I didn't mention anything to you about anxiety or depression.

key_points.text: And they say, well, you know, I've read your story in the news.
